title: Plan lane file
description: One lane of a project's plan record. The filename is the lane and sequence order is the human ranking within it.

lane.description: Must equal the file basename so a pasted fragment remains self-describing.

stories.description: Ordered highest-priority first. Position is the ranking; there is no priority field.

id.description: Quoted because unquoted 007 is octal 7 under YAML 1.1.

slug.description: Cache of the story filename suffix.

type.description: The kind of work and the condition for the worked-example gate.

points.description: Units of irreducible human judgment. Work above 3 must split.

needs.description: Ids that must be closed before this story is eligible.

epic.description: Id of one epic document at docs/plan/epics/<id>-<slug>.md. Ids are unique across stories and epics alike, so one id names one thing. Single-valued and never a sequencing fact.

tags.description: Free board labels. Nothing gates on a tag.

outcome.description: Required in closed.yml and forbidden elsewhere.

closed.description: Required in closed.yml and forbidden elsewhere; used to derive velocity.

succeeded_by.description: Required when outcome is reshaped and forbidden otherwise.
